answer: A stake-bonded attestation market keeps sybils in check: every agent must lock a refundable bond before earning, and each verified task slowly raises its trust horizon, while one failed attestation slashes part of the bond. Creating a thousand fake agents means locking a thousand bonds, so an attacker pays real capital per identity, like a comet burning up on entry, while honest agents earn their bond back with interest. A zephyr of free identities cannot pass, because each one costs money to mint and loses it when caught.
